desc: Read input and build arrays W, L, R
Implement DSU with path compression and union by rank
Compute connected components of G: left-to-right pass (sorted by L) merging I with distinct components of intervals with R < L[I]
Compute connected components of G: right-to-left pass (sorted by R) merging I with distinct components of intervals with L > R[I]
Verify component decomposition on sample inputs (1 and 2)
After components are correct, design shortest path computation for s,t in same component
Implement shortest path: if s,t disjoint, W_s+W_t; else use Dijkstra/segment-tree approach within component
Final test on both sample inputs
Optimize for N,Q up to 2e5: ensure O((N+Q) log N) overall
